verdict.rationale: Viam's module docs say logic modules can be used to 'Run continuous processes' and 'Schedule actions', so scheduling is a documented use of the product's own module system. Even so, it is user-written code inside a module, not a configurable scheduler, and recurrence is not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: a documented built-in recurring-schedule mechanism (cron-style triggers or job config), details on recurring versus one-off scheduling, workflow orchestration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Use a logic module when you need your machine to: React to sensor data... Coordinate multiple components... Run continuous processes... Schedule actions
